d: Paul Rodriguez hosts an hour of stand-up live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. See why Comedy Central named Rodriguez as one of the "Top 100 Comedians of All Time." He'll be joined by Jason Collings, Ayanna Dookie, Clint Nohr and Shane Torres.

Join host Bryan Callen and America's funniest comedians, Jesse Joyce, Rodney Laney, Jessica Kirson, Jimmy Failla and Angelo Lozada for a hilarious hour of stand-up broadcast live from the legendary Gotham Comedy Club.

Lisa Lampanelli takes the stage for a hour of hard-hitting, unrelenting stand-up comedy. Don't miss this legendary master of insults as well as Johnny Beehner, Alli Breen, Charles McBee and Jason Stuart live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.

It's the 100th episode of "Gotham Comedy Live!" Celebrate the biggest night in comedy with performances by five of America's most legendary headliners: Artie Lange, Gilbert Gottfried, Jackie "The Joke Man" Martling, Mario Cantone and Orlando Jones.

Married comedians Rich Vos and Bonnie McFarlane ("My Wife Hates Me") lead a hilarious lineup including Joe Martarese, Harrison Greenbaum, John Moses and Mike Yard. It's live, raw and unedited from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.
Paula Poundstone takes on the media in a hour of stand-up live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Come see Poundstone as she's joined by Daniel Crow, Joe Pontillo, Jermaine Warren and Greg Stone.

Vic Dibitetto takes the stage for an hour of non-stop comedy live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss Dibitetto along with Forrest Shaw, Jeff Young, Jessica Kirson and Shuli from "The Howard Stern Show."
